source_traits: 254 positive numeric AusTraits family×trait systems, 42 families, 13 traits; exact graph
estimator: Per system, excess-logK = observed logK minus the empirical mean of 64 equal-process-Brownian logK realizations on the exact observed system tree and species set.
scaled_estimator: Standardize excess-logK by the across-BM-replicate standard deviation of system logK; descriptive sensitivity, not substitute for the unscaled excess.
null_avoid_double_use: For null replicate b, center its logK using the mean across the other 63 replicates and divide by leave-one-replicate-out standard deviation. Never use replicate b itself to estimate its benchmark.
outcomes: LOFO within-family trait rank prediction gain from centered logK against 0.5 baseline
LOFO absolute centered logK prediction gain versus LOFO global mean
Same tests on per-system standardized deviations
Empirical/null exceedance with Monte Carlo correction (1+tail)/65

interpretation.positive_beyond_null: Repeated trait differences in K persist after controlling the observed-tree Brownian expectation and heteroskedastic null spread.
interpretation.not_beyond_null: Raw K rank portability may be generated largely by variation in tree geometry/tip support rather than evolutionary-process trait identity.

hard_nonclaims: Calibration remains conditional on an identical Brownian rate model; other homogeneous processes can yield different expected K patterns.
The 64-replicate standard deviations are themselves noisy.
No outcome-dependent trait exclusions or regression adjustments.
This is post-outcome sensitivity; it does not reclassify preregistered rho analyses.
